tasks.short: Remove failed loads from stock and notify supervisors.

steps.what: Remove from stock products that miss quality standards
Note discrepancies and shortages on those loads
Notify supervisors of the signed discrepancy
outputs: filed copy of signed discrepancy note v1

tasks.design: Removing products or loads that do not meet quality standards stays with the weigher. They note discrepancies or shortages. A job notifies supervisors or the appropriate department from {EMAIL} only with the signed note. The job does not remove stock.
tasks.previous_blocker: A notice could move stock before anyone had seen the defect.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be sent on the existing mail path.
tasks.still_hard: What fails the standard is still seen on the load.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher removes the load and signs the reason.
tasks.altitude: The removal stays. Sending the signed note shrinks.

reach.task: Act only on the signed note

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not move stock.
unknowns: Who must be notified for which shortage.
research_questions: How often the standard on the sheet is the wrong revision.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the removal is the moving itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every failed load is still moved by the weigher. The high end assumes only the signed notice is no longer sent by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect records for defects and the reasons for rejections.

steps.what: Inspect products and the examination records
Total defect rows on the lot, with no worker name
Determine the reasons for examiners' rejections
Determine the number of defects the weigher will stand behind

outputs: filed copy of signed defect note v1

tasks.design: The weigher inspects the products and the examination records and determines the number of defects and the reasons for examiners' rejections. A dashboard in {BI} totals defect rows already coded to the lot and does not name a worker. The weigher signs the note. A job files that version. Attributing defects to a named person is a separate consent decision and is not this job.
tasks.previous_blocker: A tally by name could become a judgement on a worker nobody had reviewed.
tasks.enabler_now: Coded lot rows can be totalled without naming a person.
tasks.still_hard: The reason for a rejection is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher determines the number they will stand behind.
tasks.altitude: The inspection stays. Totalling unnamed lot rows shrinks.

reach.task: Read only the signed defect note
reach.learn: That the total is not a score

evidence.claim: Digest [S17] says a tool that logs who did what needs works-council consent, so this job does not attribute a defect to a named person.
Digest [S14] says scoring staff by behaviour or traits is high-risk, and digest [S15] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so no such score is produced.

assumptions: A later named tally would need its own consent decision.
unknowns: Whether the office is allowed to keep a named tally at all.
research_questions: How often a defect row has no lot id.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the inspection is the looking itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every rejection reason is still read by the weigher. The high end assumes only unnamed lot totals are no longer added by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Store finished samples in labeled cartons and record location.

steps.what: Store samples of finished products in labeled cartons
State their location for the record

outputs: filed copy of signed sample location v1

tasks.design: Storing samples of finished products in labeled cartons stays with the weigher. They state the location. A job files that location in {ERP} only after the weigher signs it. The job does not move a carton.
tasks.previous_blocker: A location could be recorded for a carton that was still on the bench.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed location can be filed on the existing record.
tasks.still_hard: Putting the sample in the carton is still done by hand.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher stores the sample and signs the location.
tasks.altitude: The storing stays. Filing the signed location shrinks.

reach.task: Find the sample only at the signed location

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not store a sample.
unknowns: Which carton series is in use.
research_questions: How often a location is reused.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the store step is the storing itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every sample is still stored by the weigher. The high end assumes only the signed location is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Count or estimate quantities received or shipped.

steps.what: Count quantities of materials, parts, or products
Estimate quantities that cannot be counted
Compare the count with received or shipped orders

outputs: filed copy of signed quantity v1

tasks.design: The weigher counts or estimates quantities of materials, parts, or products received or shipped. A job in {ERP} compares that count with the order quantity. The weigher signs the quantity. A job files that version. A gap is not a shortage until the weigher signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: An order quantity could be stored as the count when nobody had counted.
tasks.enabler_now: A captured count can be compared with the order.
tasks.still_hard: The count and any estimate are still made on the goods.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher signs the quantity they will stand behind.

ambition.what: Show a gap on the same shift, and file only the signed quantity.

tasks.altitude: The count stays. Comparing it with the order shrinks.

reach.learn: Which order it was compared with

evidence.claim: The records digest says matching a label, a manifest, and an order is plain code.

unknowns: When an estimate is allowed instead of a count.
research_questions: How often the order quantity is itself wrong.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the count step is the counting itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every lot is still counted by the weigher. The high end assumes only the comparison with the order is no longer done by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The weigher spends the shift on the scale, the sample, and the check. A captured quantity can be filed after they sign it. The scale's own readout is not saved human time.
reach: A supervisor sees a shortage only from the note the weigher signed.
The laboratory receives the sample the weigher prepared, not a generated result.
skills_to_grow: Tell a scale readout from a quantity they are willing to sign.
Refuse a tally that names a worker as the cause of a defect.
role.ambitious_version: A signed quantity can be on the shipping record the same shift, and the weigher still signs it.
